ActiveSettings.description: The `ActiveContractSettings` of a template, each flag as stored.

AiName.description: The name an NPC gets (`MissionPropertyValue_AIName`): drawn at random or given.

detonationDamage.description: The damage of the detonation, from the `damage` of `explosionParams`.

geometryTagGuids.description: The GUIDs of the `Tag` Records of `geometries`, in stored order.

groupIndex.description:
The index in `groups` of the group the modified element is in; `null` when the weak
pointer `harvestableElement` does not point into this Record.

harvestableIndex.description: The index in the group's `harvestables` of the modified element.

ArmorStats.description: The suit armour of an item, raw facts of `SCItemSuitArmorParams` (ADR-0072).

damageResistance.description:
The `damageResistance` of the `DamageResistanceMacro` Record that `damageResistance` links
to; `null` without a readable one.

AutoFinish.description: The `ContractAutoFinishSettings` of a template, each value as stored.

completionTime.description:
The `missionCompletionTime` of the deadline, as stored; the Archive does not state its
unit. `null` when the template has no deadline.

remainingTimeToShowTimer.description: The `remainingTimeToShowTimer` of the deadline, as stored.

resultAfterTimerEnd.description: The `missionResultAfterTimerEnd` of the deadline: the state the mission ends in.

AutoSpawnSettings.description: The `AutoSpawnSettings` of an NPC option: how many NPCs spawn, where and with what.

characterTags.description: The `positiveCharacterTags` and `negativeCharacterTags` the character is searched by.

excludeSpawnGender.description: The `excludeSpawnGender` as the enum `EExcludeSpawnGender` stores it.

factionOverrideGuid.description: The `factionOverride` `Faction` Record, `null` when absent; no kind lists these Records.

maxSpawnDelay.description: The `maxSpawnDelay`; the Archive states no unit.

minGroupSize.description: The `minGroupSize`; `-1` as stored means no minimum.

minSpawnDelay.description: The `minSpawnDelay`; the Archive states no unit.

name.description: The `name`, a developer's label such as `SC_CE -> DA_I (Grenadier x1)`; `null` when empty.

Availability.description: When and to whom an entry is offered.

wantedLevelMax.description:
The highest wanted level (`reputationPrerequisites.wantedLevel.maxValue`) the player may
have.

wantedLevelMin.description:
The lowest wanted level (`reputationPrerequisites.wantedLevel.minValue`) the player may
have.

Blueprint.description: A crafting blueprint: a `CraftingBlueprintRecord` Record under `crafting/blueprints/crafting`.

categoryGuid.description:
The GUID of the category Record, the `guid` of a `blueprintCategories` entry; `null`
without a category or when its Record is a left-out leftover or unreadable.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `BP_CRAFT_behr_lmg_ballistic_01_mag`.

craftTimeSeconds.description: The craft time of the first tier in seconds, `null` without one.

defaultAvailable.description:
Whether the blueprint is one the player has by default
(`CraftingGlobalParams.defaultBlueprintSelection`).

dismantle.description:
What dismantling the produced item returns, `null` without a produced item, for an item
that cannot be dismantled, and unless the Build holds exactly one dismantle process.

ingredients.description:
The ingredients of the first tier in stored order, derived from `tiers`: a selection is
flattened depth first, so its count, quantity multipliers and quality modifiers are not
represented here.

key.description: The blueprint key, the Record name.

name.description: The name, from `CraftingBlueprint.blueprintName`.

producedItemGuid.description:
The GUID of the entity the blueprint produces, `null` without one or for a Reference to
a Record the DataForge lacks.

tiers.description:
Every tier in stored order with its craft time and its costs, selections kept as
`select` lines. The first one is the tier `craftTimeSeconds` and `ingredients` describe.

BlueprintCategory.description:
A blueprint category: a `BlueprintCategoryRecord` Record under `crafting/blueprintcategories`,
the target of the `categoryGuid` of a blueprint.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `FPSArmours`.

name.description: The name; the Record holds no field for one, so the key is `null`.

BlueprintDismantle.description:
What dismantling the item of a blueprint returns: a link to the process and the tier.

The item returns the share `efficiency` of the process of the costs of the tier `tierIndex`,
except the resources in `craftingGlobal.dismantleExcludedResourceGuids`. A `select` is not
resolved and the quantity multiplier is not applied; these are assumptions, not verified
against the game.

tierIndex.description:
The index into `tiers` of the tier whose costs are returned, `null` for a blueprint
without a tier.

BlueprintPool.description:
A blueprint pool: a `BlueprintPoolRecord` under `crafting/blueprintrewards` that a reward
draws a blueprint from.

A source gives the blueprint of an entry with the chance of the source times the weight of the
entry over `totalWeight`.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

rewardSources.description: The places that reward a blueprint of the pool, found through their Reference to it.

totalWeight.description: The sum of the positive weights of the entries.

BlueprintReward.description: A blueprint pool a contract hands out.

chance.description: The `chance` of the reward as stored, `null` when it states none (a modifier has none).

poolGuid.description: The `guid` of the entry of `blueprintPools` the reward draws from.

source.description: The struct that states the reward.

BlueprintSource.description: The struct that states a blueprint reward.

x-values.description: A `BlueprintRewards` result that fires on success.
An enabled `MissionModifier_TemporaryBlueprint` of the parameter overrides.

BlueprintTier.description: One tier of a blueprint: its craft time and its costs.

craftTimeSeconds.description: The craft time of the tier in whole seconds, `null` without one.

mandatory.description: The mandatory cost, usually a `select`; `null` without one.

optional.description: The optional costs in stored order.

BrokerEntry.description:
A mission broker entry: a `MissionBrokerEntry` Record, an offer of the mission board. A
contract names it in `brokerEntryGuid`; one without a template takes its title, type and
location from it. The grouped fields (`names`, `links`, `module` and `tags`) are written flat.

associatedMissionGuids.description: The `associatedMissions`, entries of `missionBrokerEntries`, in stored order.

availability.description: When and to whom the entry is offered.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

cooldowns.description: The cooldowns and the respawn time.

entitySpawns.description: The entity spawn descriptions the entry states, resolved like `shipSpawns`.

finish.description: The failure conditions and the deadline.

giverGuid.description: The `missionGiverRecord`, a mission giver Record; no kind lists these.

guid.description: The GUID of the Record; the `brokerEntryGuid` of the contracts that name it.

haulingOrders.description: The orders of the hauling objectives of the entry (`source` `brokerObjective`).

instances.description: How many instances run and for how long.

journalEntriesOnComplete.description: The `journalEntriesToAddOnComplete`, journal Records; no kind lists these.

journalEntriesOnRemove.description: The `journalEntriesToRemoveOnComplete`, journal Records; no kind lists these.

locationQueries.description: The location queries the entry states, resolved like `shipSpawns`.

missionGiver.description: The `missionGiver`: the name the game shows as the giver.

missionProperties.description:
The mission properties of `properties` in stored order: the variables the objectives and
modifiers refer to.

module.description: The `missionModule` file of the mission scripting, `null` when empty.

notForRelease.description: The `notForRelease` flag as stored, `null` when absent.

npcSpawns.description: The NPC spawn descriptions the entry states, resolved like `shipSpawns`.

objectives.description: The objective tokens in depth-first order, each phase after its parent.

owner.description: The `owner` of the Record, `null` when it names none.

partialPayout.description: The `partialRewardPayout`, `null` when the entry has none.

reputationResults.description: The `missionResultReputationRewards`, one element per stored position.

requiredCompletedTags.description:
The `requiredCompletedMissionTags`: the player has completed missions that carry the
positive and none that carry the negative tags of each term.

requiredMissionGuids.description: The `requiredMissions`, entries of `missionBrokerEntries`, in stored order.

schedule.description: The windows the entry is offered in, in stored order.

shipSpawns.description:
The ship spawn descriptions the entry states, one per variable, ordered by variable; `level`
is always `broker`.

unlessAvailableMissionGuids.description:
The `onlyAvailableIfAllMissionsNotAvailable`, entries of `missionBrokerEntries`: the entry
is offered only while none of them is.

changeNumber.description: The Perforce change number the Build was made from.

publicPatch.description:
The public patch version, e.g. `4.7.2`, from the RSI Launcher log line with the same
change number; `null` when the log has none.

CargoFillType.description: How a cargo manifest shares the capacity among its resources.

x-values.description: `CargoFillCapacityValue_Custom`: every resource states its own share.

CargoManifest.description:
A cargo manifest: a `CargoManifest` Record under `cargomanifest`, which tells the game how to
fill the cargo grid of a ship it spawns.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `LegalCargo_TSG`.

fillType.description: How the capacity is shared among `resources`: the type of `cargoFillCapacity`.

maxCapacityRange.description:
The highest share of the cargo capacity that is filled (`maxCapacityRange`, 0 to 1);
`null` for a `custom` fill.

minCapacityRange.description:
The lowest share of the cargo capacity that is filled (`minCapacityRange`, 0 to 1);
`null` for a `custom` fill, which states shares per resource.

resources.description: The resources of `cargoFillCapacity`, in stored order.

CargoManifestResource.description: One resource of a cargo manifest.

maxAllocation.description:
The highest share of the capacity of a `custom` fill
(`maxResourceAllocationPercentage`, as stored); `null` for the other fills.

minAllocation.description:
The lowest share of the capacity of a `custom` fill
(`minResourceAllocationPercentage`, as stored); `null` for the other fills.

probability.description: The `probability` that the resource is picked, as stored.

resourceGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record, the `subtypeGuid` of a commodity; `null` when the
resource is absent. A GUID that no commodity of the catalog carries is kept.

CargoSpawnKind.description: What a spawn rule of a cargo manifest lists.

CargoSpawnRule.description: A spawn rule of a cargo manifest: a set of entities or resources the game adds to the cargo.

entityGuids.description: The `EntityClassDefinition` Records of an `entities` rule, in stored order.

kind.description: Whether the rule lists entities or resources.

probability.description: The `probability` of the rule, as stored.

proportion.description: The `proportion` of a proportion quantity; `null` for another algorithm.

quantity.description: The `quantity` of a fixed quantity; `null` for another algorithm.

resourceGuids.description: The `ResourceType` Records of a `resources` rule, in stored order.

CategoryRule.description:
A polymorphic struct that names blueprint categories: the condition of a modifier or the
availability of a queue.

blueprintCategoryGuids.description:
The `guid`s of the `blueprintCategories` entries `categories` links to, in stored order;
`[]` for `none` and `unknown`.

kind.description:
Which struct it is, as the parent field documents; `unknown` keeps an unrecognised struct
without values. A closed set the game may extend, so the schema keeps a string.

structName.description: The name of the struct; `null` when the field holds none.

ClothingStats.description: The worn properties of an item, raw facts of `SCItemClothingParams`.

Commodity.description:
A commodity: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/commodities` or a
`ResourceType` Record that a blueprint cost or a quality quantization uses and no commodity
Record carries.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Gold`.

densityGramsPerCubicCentimetre.description:
The density of the `ResourceType` in grams per cubic centimetre (game field
`gramsPerCubicCentimeter`), `null` without a `ResourceType`, a density or a density in
another unit.

description.description:
The description, from the entity's display parameters or, without one, from the
`ResourceType` Record of the commodity.

displayType.description:
The display type of the purchasable parameters, e.g. `@items_commodities_type_metal`;
without a key for a `ResourceType` entry.

guid.description: The GUID of the Record; for a `ResourceType` entry the GUID of the `ResourceType`.

name.description: The name, from `SCItemPurchasableParams.displayName`.

refinedSubtypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record `refinedVersion` of the `ResourceType` links to; `null`
without a `ResourceType` or a `refinedVersion`. It equals the `subtypeGuid` of the refined
commodity only when the catalog has that commodity.

subtypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record the commodity's default composition holds first,
`null` without one. The `resourceGuid` of an ingredient equals the
`subtypeGuid` of exactly one commodity.

typeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceTypeGroup` Record that directly lists the `ResourceType`, the
`guid` of a `resourceGroups` entry; `null` without a `ResourceType` or a group.

CommsTiming.description:
When a comms notification is shown relative to its HUD notification. A value the catalog
does not know is `null`.

Comparison.description: How a reputation requirement compares the standing of the player with the one it names.

x-values.description: The standing is at least as high (`GreaterThanOrEqualTo`).
The standing is at most as high (`LessThanOrEqualTo`).

CompositionPart.description: One part of a mineable composition: an element with the range of its share.

mineableElementGuid.description:
The GUID of the `MineableElement` Record the Reference `mineableElement` links to; `null`
for a null Reference. The catalog lists the element only when it is kept.

probability.description: `probability` that the part occurs, from 0.02 to 1 on LIVE.

ContractEntry.description:
A contract or one of its sub contracts, with the overrides of sub contract, contract and
handler laid over the template.

abandonedCooldownTime.description:
The `abandonedCooldownTime`, as stored: the cooldown after the player abandons the
contract, in the unit of `personalCooldownTime`; `null` when absent.

abandonedCooldownTimeVariation.description:
The `abandonedCooldownTimeVariation`, as stored, in the unit of `personalCooldownTime`;
`null` when absent.

blueprintRewards.description:
The blueprint pools the contract hands out, from its own resolved results: those of the
sub contract when it states any, else of the contract. A contract that hands out none
has an empty list.

brokerEntryGuid.description:
The GUID of the `MissionBrokerEntry` Record the contract names in `missionBrokerEntry`, an
entry of `missionBrokerEntries`; `null` when it names none.

buyInAmount.description:
The `contractBuyInAmount` of the contract's `contractResults`, as stored; `null` when
absent. A sub contract shares the contract's value.

canBeShared.description: Parameter `CanBeShared`; base: `canBeShared` of the template's contract class.

contractor.description:
The `Contractor` string parameter of the first level that states one (sub contract,
contract, handler): the text the game shows as the giver of the contract, e.g. the
agency, when the contract has no faction reputation.

cooldownLayer.description:
The nearest level that states any of the five fields, `null` when none does. A field that
level does not state comes from a farther level; `cooldownLayers` names each field's level.

cooldownLayers.description: The level that states each of the five fields.

debugName.description: The `debugName` of the contract, `null` when it has none.

description.description:
The description, resolved like the title: the `Description` of the sub contract, else of
the contract, else of the handler, else the `description` of the contract's
`MissionBrokerEntry`. A game text that must not be passed on to third parties. The
template states none.

entitySpawns.description:
The entity spawn descriptions the contract states, resolved like `shipSpawns`: `poolGuid` is
an entry of `contractEntitySpawns`.

faction.description:
The `factionReputation` of the handler, as stored: the faction of a contract that has no
reputation result, e.g. the collector's. `null` when the handler names none.

giverFaction.description:
The faction of the contract and where it was found: `faction` (source `handler`), else the
first reputation amount granted on success that is positive (`reputationResult`; a negative
amount names a rival), else the first reputation prerequisite that is no exclusion
(`reputationPrerequisite`). `null` when none names a faction. `faction` itself stays the
handler's value.

handler.description: The `debugName` of the handler that holds the contract, `null` when it has none.

hasPersonalCooldown.description: Whether the contract has a personal cooldown (`hasPersonalCooldown`), `null` when absent.

haulingOrders.description:
What the contract has to haul: per `missionVariableName` the hauling orders property of the
nearest level (sub contract, contract, handler, template), then the orders of the hauling
objectives of the template, else of the `MissionBrokerEntry`. Empty for a contract that
hauls nothing. Where to pick up and drop off is not stated here: the game fills those
properties in when the mission starts.

illegal.description: Parameter `Illegal`; base: `illegal` of the template's display info.

locationPrerequisites.description:
The `ContractPrerequisite_LocationProperty` prerequisites of handler, contract and sub
contract, in that order and as stored: the contract is offered at the location the named
variable of `locationQueries` resolves to. On LIVE four contracts (the North Rock PVP
bounties) name a variable no query states.

locationQueries.description:
The location queries the contract states, resolved like `shipSpawns`. The game runs a
query when the mission starts; the catalog does not.

maxPlayersPerInstance.description:
Parameter `MaxPlayersPerInstance`; base: `maxPlayersPerInstance` of the handler's
`defaultAvailability`. A negative value is as stored.

maxStandingGuid.description:
The `maxStanding` of the contract: the highest standing that is offered it; `null` when
the contract states none. A sub contract shares the contract's value.

minStandingGuid.description:
The `minStanding` of the contract: the lowest standing that is offered it, the `guid` of an
entry of `reputationStandings`; `null` when the contract states none. A sub contract
shares the contract's value.

missionType.description: The localised name of the mission type.

missionTypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `MissionType` Record: the override of the sub contract, else of the
contract, else of the handler, else the type of the template, else the type of the
contract's `MissionBrokerEntry`; `null` when there is none.

notForRelease.description: Whether the contract is marked `notForRelease`, `null` when the flag is absent.

npcSpawns.description:
The NPC spawn descriptions the contract states, resolved like `shipSpawns`: `poolGuid` is an
entry of `contractNpcSpawns`.

offeredAt.description:
Every place the contract is offered at, without the cap of `pickupPlaces`: the localities
and location objects of the same prerequisites, as stated.

personalCooldownTime.description:
The `personalCooldownTime`, as stored; `null` when absent. The Archive does not state the
unit; the value range (up to 2880 in a handler, 10080 in a contract override) fits minutes.

personalCooldownTimeVariation.description:
The `personalCooldownTimeVariation`, as stored, in the unit of `personalCooldownTime`;
`null` when absent.

pickupPlaces.description:
Where the contract is offered or picked up, at most five starmap objects: those of the
`MissionLocality` and location prerequisites of the sub contract (else of the contract and
its handler), a star left out, the star system first, then planets and moons, then the
rest, each group in stored order. When none of those is left (nothing named, or only stars
or objects missing from `starmapObjects`), the `locationMissionAvailable` of the contract's
`MissionBrokerEntry`. Empty when that names none either or the starmap objects are not part
of the catalog build.

recordGuid.description: The GUID of the `ContractGenerator` Record that holds the contract.

recordPath.description: The record path of the `ContractGenerator` Record, without `.xml`.

reputationGains.description:
The reputation the contract grants on success, one entry per amount: the results whose
first mission result (success) is set. A result that fires on failure only is left out; an
amount may be negative (a success that costs standing with a rival, as stored).

requiredIntros.description:
The `ContractPrerequisite_CompletedContractTags` tags of the handler, the contract and the
sub contract, in that order and as stored, each with the intro contracts that grant the tag.
The catalog does not decide how the levels combine.

shipSpawns.description:
The ship spawn descriptions the contract states, one per `missionVariableName`, ordered by
variable: the first of sub contract, contract, handler and template that states the
variable wins; a description without a group is left out.

standingRequirements.description:
The `ContractPrerequisite_Reputation` prerequisites of the handler, the contract and the
sub contract, in that order and as stored. The catalog does not decide how they combine.

subContractGuid.description:
The `id` of the sub contract; `null` for the contract itself. A contract with sub
contracts has its own entry and one entry per sub contract.

templateGuid.description: The GUID of the `ContractTemplate` Record the contract names, `null` when it names none.

timeToComplete.description:
The `timeToComplete` of the contract's `contractResults`, as stored, in floating point;
`null` when absent. A sub contract shares the contract's value. The Archive states no unit.

title.description:
The title: the `Title` of the sub contract, else of the contract, else of the handler, else
the first display string of the template, else the title of the contract's
`MissionBrokerEntry`. A `~mission(Token)` in it is replaced by the text the first of sub
contract, contract, handler and template states for the token, or by a placeholder such as
`[LOCATION]`, `[TARGET]` or `[SHIP]` for what the game picks when the mission starts, or
`[TOKEN]` when nothing states it. Trailing and leading blanks are removed.

workInProgress.description: Whether the contract is marked `workInProgress`, `null` when the flag is absent.

ContractFaction.description: The faction a handler names for its contracts.

displayName.description: The `displayName` of the faction reputation, e.g. `Wikelo Emporium`.

guid.description: The GUID of the faction reputation Record.

name.description: The Record name of the faction reputation, e.g. `factionreputation_wikelo`.

ContractScenario.description:
A contract scenario: a `ScenarioProgress` Record under `contracts/contractscenarios`, the
rewards a community progression hands out.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `ORS_ScenarioProgress`.

factionRewardTiers.description: The reward tiers per faction (`factionRewardTiers`), in the stored order.

ContractTemplate.description:
A contract template: a `ContractTemplate` Record under `contracts/contracttemplates`, the
structure a contract names in `templateGuid` and lays its own overrides over.

autoFinish.description: The `autoFinishSettings` of the contract class, `null` when it has none.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `AcePilot` for `ContractTemplate.AcePilot`.

classType.description: The struct of the `contractClass`, e.g. `ContractClass_Contract`; `null` when absent.

contractProperties.description:
The mission properties of `contractProperties` in stored order: the variables the
contracts, handlers and sub contracts override.

entitySpawns.description: The entity spawn descriptions the template states, resolved like `shipSpawns`.

guid.description: The GUID of the Record; the `templateGuid` of the contracts that name it.

haulingOrders.description:
The hauling orders of the template: the hauling properties (`template`) and the orders of
its hauling objectives (`templateObjective`).

illegal.description: The `illegal` flag of the display info, `null` when absent.

locationQueries.description: The location queries the template states, resolved like `shipSpawns`.

missionTypeGuid.description:
The `MissionType` Record of the display info, an entry of `missionTypes`; the GUID is kept
for a Record the Archive lacks.

notForRelease.description: The `notForRelease` flag as stored, `null` when absent.

npcSpawns.description: The NPC spawn descriptions the template states, resolved like `shipSpawns`.

objectives.description: The objective tokens in depth-first order, each phase after its parent.

owner.description: The `owner` of the Record, `null` when it names none.

partialPayout.description: The `partialRewardPayout`, `null` when the template has none.

preShowObjectives.description: The `preShowObjectives` flag of the display info, `null` when absent.

settings.description: The `ActiveContractSettings` of the contract class, `null` when it has none.

shipSpawns.description:
The ship spawn descriptions the template states, one per variable, ordered by variable;
`level` is always `template`.

showLifeTimeInMobiGlas.description: The `showLifeTimeInMobiGlas` flag of the display info, `null` when absent.

title.description: The first display string of the template; `null` text for a placeholder.

workInProgress.description: The `workInProgress` flag as stored, `null` when absent.

CooldownLayers.description: The level that states each cooldown field of an entry; `null` for a field no level states.

Cooldowns.description: The cooldowns and the respawn time of an entry.

abandonedCooldownTime.description: The `abandonedCooldownTime`, the cooldown after the player abandons the mission.

coolingRate.description:
The `amount` of the first `generation` flow of `resourceStates` whose resource is
`Coolant`.

CostLine.description:
One cost of a tier: a selection ("choose n") of costs, a resource line or an item line.

The fields of the other lines are `null`, or empty for `options` and `modifiers`.

compositionInclusion.description:
The option of `CraftingCostContext_ResultCompositionInclusion`, e.g. `Include`; `null`
without one. A closed set the game may extend.

count.description:
A `select`: how many options the player chooses, `null` when the Record holds no count.
Fewer than `options` offers means the player may leave options out.

itemGuid.description: An `item`: the GUID of the entity.

kind.description:
What the line is: `select`, `resource` or `item`. A closed set; a reader maps an unknown
value to nothing.

minQuality.description: A `resource` or `item`: the minimum quality, `null` without one.

modifiers.description:
The gameplay properties the line's quality scales
(`CraftingCostContext_ResultGameplayPropertyModifiers`).

options.description: A `select`: the options in stored order.

quantityMultiplier.description: The `CraftingCostContext_QuantityMultiplier` factor of the line, `null` without one.

quantityScu.description: A `resource`: the quantity in standard cargo units (SCU), before the quantity multiplier.

quantityUnits.description: An `item`: the number of units, before the quantity multiplier.

resourceGuid.description: A `resource`: the GUID of the `ResourceType` Record.

slot.description: A `select`: the debug name of the slot, `null` without one.

slotKey.description: A `select`: the localisation key of the slot name, `null` without one or for a placeholder.

Crafter.description: A crafting station: an entity whose `Components` hold a `CrafterComponentParams`.

baseCraftingTime.description: `baseCraftingTime`; `null` when the Record stores no number.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

hostGuids.description:
The GUIDs of the ships whose Default Loadout mounts the crafter in any port, ordered by
GUID; empty for a crafter no ship mounts, e.g. a station.

issues.description:
The codes of the problems found in the modifiers and queues, e.g. `unknown_modifier_type`,
sorted and without duplicates; empty when everything was understood.

maxJobsInHistory.description: `maxJobsInHistory`: how many finished jobs the station lists.

modifiers.description: The crafting modifiers, from `modifiers` in stored order; `[]` without any.

queues.description: The job queues, from `queues` in stored order.

type.description:
`AttachDef.Type` of the entity, e.g. `Crafter`; `null` without an `AttachDef`. With
`subType` and `size` it is what a port's `types` and size range are matched against.

CrafterModifier.description: A crafting modifier of a [`Crafter`]: a `CraftingModifierParams`.

condition.description:
When the modifier applies: the struct `modifierCondition` holds. `kind` is
`blueprintCategory`, `none` (no condition stored) or `unknown`.

structName.description: The name of the struct `modifierType` holds; `null` for none.

timeMultiplier.description:
`timeMultiplier` of a `time` modifier: the factor on the crafting time (below 1 is
faster); `null` for any other type or when the Record stores no number.

type.description:
What the modifier changes: `time` (`CraftingModifierType_Time`), `none` (no
`modifierType` stored) or `unknown` (a struct this export does not know, kept with its
`structName` and no values). A closed set the game may extend, so the schema keeps a
string.

blueprintCategoryAvailability.description:
The blueprint categories the queue accepts: the struct `blueprintCategoryAvailability`
holds. `kind` is `whitelist`, `none` or `unknown`.

maxJobsInProgress.description: `maxJobsInProgress`: how many jobs the queue crafts at once.

maxJobsWaiting.description: `maxJobsWaiting`: how many further jobs the queue holds.

name.description: `debugName`.

processTypeAvailability.description:
`processTypeAvailability` as stored: one boolean per process type, in the order of the
game's process types, which the Archive does not name; `[]` when the Record has none.

CraftingGlobal.description: The `CraftingGlobalParams` Records, merged: what applies to every dismantle.

dismantleExcludedItemGuids.description: The entities that cannot be dismantled; their blueprints have no `dismantle`.

Damage.description: Damage by type, as the Archive states it.

DamageResistance.description: The resistances of a `DamageResistanceMacro`, one entry per damage type.

DismantleProcess.description:
A generic dismantle process: a `CraftingBlueprintRecord` under `crafting/blueprints/dismantle`
whose process is a `GenericCraftingProcess_Dismantle`.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

efficiency.description:
The share of the costs a dismantled item returns, 0 to 1, `null` when the Record holds
none.

timeSeconds.description: The dismantle time in whole seconds, `null` when the Record holds none.

EndComms.description: A `ContractEndCommsNotification`: a message sent when the contract ends.

communicationTag.description: The tag path of the `communicationTags` tag.

reason.description: How the contract ended; `null` for a value the catalog does not know.

EntitySpawnGroup.description: A group of entities that spawn together (`SpawnDescription_EntityGroup`).

name.description: The `Name` of the group, `null` when empty.

slots.description: The entities of the group, one slot each.

EntitySpawnOption.description:
One alternative of an entity slot (`SpawnDescription_Entity`): an entity the game picks by
tags.

amount.description: The `amount` of entities that spawn; `null` when absent.

negativeTags.description: The `negativeTags` a match must not carry.

tags.description: The `tags` the game searches entities by.

weight.description: The `weight` of the alternative among its slot; `null` when absent.

EntitySpawnPool.description:
An entity spawn description of a contract: what a
`MissionPropertyValue_EntitySpawnDescriptions` property states, shared by every contract that
states the same.

guid.description: The identifier of the content (see the catalog documentation); not a GUID of the Archive.

EntitySpawnSlot.description: The alternatives for one entity (`SpawnDescription_EntityOptions`): the game spawns one of them.

EscalatingClaims.description: The `escalatingClaimsParams` of the item recovery rules.

ExplosionPool.description:
The numbers of `mineableExplosionParams` of a [`MiningGlobalParams`] besides the default
explosion.

FactLayer.description:
The level that states a value of a contract; the variants run from the nearest level to the
farthest.

x-values.description: The parameter overrides of the sub contract.
The parameter overrides of the contract.
The parameter overrides or the `defaultAvailability` of the handler.

allied.description:
The scope and standing a member of the faction holds towards an allied faction
(`alliedParams`), `null` when the Record has none.

allyGuids.description: The factions it counts as allies, as stored.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `FactionReputation_Wikelo`.

contextGuid.description:
The `SReputationContextUI` Record the faction is shown with (`reputationContextPropertiesUI`),
`null` when it names none.

enemyGuids.description: The factions it counts as enemies, as stored.

hostility.description:
The scope and standing a member of the faction holds towards a hostile faction
(`hostilityParams`), `null` when the Record has none.

lawful.description:
Whether the faction is lawful: the value of the boolean `entityLawful` property of its
`propertiesBB`, `null` when it has none.

lifetime.description: `modifierLifetime.lifetime`, in seconds; `null` for a modifier that lasts.

Finish.description: The failure conditions and the deadline of an entry.

resultAfterTimerEnd.description: The `missionResultAfterTimerEnd` of the deadline: the state the mission ends in.

FireAction.description: One fire mode of a weapon.

chargeTime.description: `chargeTime` of the fire mode, when stated, in seconds.

cooldownTime.description: `cooldownTime` of the fire mode, when stated, in seconds.

damagePerSecond.description: `damagePerSecond`, the damage a beam does each second; `null` for a mode without one.

fireRate.description:
`fireRate`, in rounds per minute. `fireRate`, `heatPerShot`, `chargeTime`,
`overchargeTime`, `cooldownTime`, `name` and `launchParams` are read from the fire mode and,
where it has none of its own, from its `weaponAction`.

fullDamageRange.description: `fullDamageRange` of a beam, in metres: the distance up to which it does full damage.

hitType.description:
`hitType` of a beam, e.g. `ElectricArc` for a mining beam and `Extraction` for an
extraction beam. A closed set the game may extend; the schema keeps a string.

kind.description:
The struct of the fire mode, e.g. `SWeaponActionFireRapidParams`. A closed set the game
may extend; the schema keeps a string.

name.description: The `name` of the fire mode.

overchargeTime.description: `overchargeTime` of the fire mode, when stated, in seconds.

pellets.description:
`launchParams.pelletCount` (`pellets` where a Record states that instead), the projectiles
of one shot.

zeroDamageRange.description: `zeroDamageRange` of a beam, in metres: the distance from which it does no damage.

FireActionModifier.description: The damage multiplier an `ItemWeaponModifiersParams` applies to one fire action of the laser.

fireActionIndex.description: `fireActionIndex`, the index into the laser's `fireActions` as stored.

lifetime.description: `modifierLifetime.lifetime`, in seconds; `null` for a modifier that lasts.

FixedReward.description:
A payout a contract states itself (`ContractResult_Reward`), as stored. Most contracts pay
through `ContractResult_CalculatedReward`, which holds no amount.

currency.description: The currency of the payout (`currencyType`), e.g. `UEC`; `null` when absent.

max.description: The `max` amount; `null` when absent. Zero when fixed.

plusBonuses.description: The `plusBonuses` flag: whether the game adds bonuses on top; `null` when absent.

FlowAction.description: An action of a mission flow trigger (`MissionFlowAction_*`), as stored.

objectiveId.description: The `objectiveToken`, `null` when it points to none.

oneOf.description: `MissionFlowAction_PickRandomMissionPhase`: one of the phases becomes active.

FlowCondition.description:
A condition of a mission flow trigger (`MissionFlowCondition_*`), as stored. An objective
is the `id` of an entry of `objectives`.

oneOf.description: `MissionFlowCondition_TokenState`: an objective is in a state.

objectiveId.description: The `objectiveToken`, `null` when it points to none.

oneOf.description: `MissionFlowCondition_AllTokensState`: every objective is in a state.
`MissionFlowCondition_AnyTokensState`: some objective is in a state.
`MissionFlowCondition_PropertyIsSet`: a mission property has a value.

FlowTrigger.description: A trigger of the mission flow: when its condition holds, its action runs.

note.description: The `description` as stored, a developer's note on the trigger; `null` when empty.

GameplayProperty.description:
A gameplay property definition: a `CraftingGameplayPropertyDef` Record under
`crafting/craftedproperties`, the target of the `propertyGuid` of a modifier.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

name.description: The name of the property; a placeholder key leaves `en` and `de` `null`.

GiverFaction.description: The faction a contract is stated for, with the place that states it.

GiverSource.description: Where the faction of a contract was found.

x-values.description:
The faction of the first reputation amount the contract grants on success whose
`reputationAmount` is positive.
The faction of the first `ContractPrerequisite_Reputation` that is not an exclusion.

Guid.description: A GUID as canonical lower-case UUID text.

HarvestableArea.description: One area of a provider preset.

modifiers.description: The modifiers of the area, from `modifiers` in stored order.

name.description: `debugGroupName`, e.g. `Acidic`.

objectPresetPaths.description: `objectPresetPaths` of the area type, in stored order.

clusteringGuid.description: The GUID of the `HarvestableClusterPreset` Record the Reference `clustering` links to.

geometryTagGuids.description: The GUIDs of the `Tag` Records of `geometries`, in stored order.

harvestable.description:
What the element spawns; `null` when the element names neither a harvestable nor an
entity.

setupGuid.description: The GUID of the Record the Reference `harvestableSetup` links to.

HarvestableGroup.description: A group of harvestables of a provider preset.

harvestables.description: The harvestables of the group, from `harvestables` in stored order.

HarvestableLink.description:
What a harvestable spawns, followed from the `HarvestablePreset` Record to the entity and its
mining parameters.

entityGuid.description:
The GUID of the entity: `harvestableEntityClass` of the element, else `entityClass` of the
preset.

mineableCompositionGuid.description:
The GUID of the `MineableComposition` Record the entity's `MineableParams` link to; `null`
for an entity that is not mineable.

miningGlobalParamsGuid.description: The GUID of the `MiningGlobalParams` Record the entity's `MineableParams` link to.

presetClassName.description:
The Record name of the `HarvestablePreset` without its type, e.g.
`Mining_Common_Aluminum`; `null` for none or an unreadable Record.

presetGuid.description:
The GUID of the `HarvestablePreset` Record the Reference `harvestable` links to; `null`
when the element names an entity only.

HarvestableLocation.description:
A place a harvestable provider preset is used: a container whose `.soc` names the preset, with
the starmap object it hangs below.

container.description: The Archive path of the container (`.socpak`).

starmapObjectGuid.description:
The GUID of the `StarMapObject` the container hangs below: the nearest object at or above
the container's Child element, a mining claim marker left out; `null` when none.

system.description:
The folder of the star system below `Data/ObjectContainers/PU/system` that reaches the
container.

HarvestableProviderPreset.description:
A harvestable provider preset: a `HarvestableProviderPreset` Record under
`harvestable/providerpresets`, what a place can spawn. Which places use it is in
`harvestableLocations`.

areas.description: The areas of the surface, from `areas` in stored order.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `HPP_Stanton1a`.

groups.description: The groups, from `harvestableGroups` in stored order.

entityClassGuid.description: The GUID of the `EntityClassDefinition` Record of an `entityClass` item.

entityClassesGuid.description:
The GUID of the `Hauling_EntityClasses` Record of an `entityClasses` item: a list of
entity classes of which any one counts. No kind lists these Records.

kind.description: What kind of thing the item is.

maxAmount.description: The `maxAmount` of an item that counts pieces, as stored; 0 when it states no upper bound.

maxContainerSize.description: The `maxContainerSize` of a `resource` item, as stored; -1 when it states no limit.

maxScu.description: The `maxSCU` of a `resource` item, as stored; 0 when the order states no upper bound.

minAmount.description: The `minAmount` of an item that counts pieces, as stored.

minScu.description: The `minSCU` of a `resource` item, as stored.

resourceGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record of a `resource` item, the `subtypeGuid` of a
commodity; `null` for another kind or when the item names none. A GUID of a `ResourceType`
that no commodity of the catalog carries is kept.

HaulingItemKind.description: What a hauling item stands for.

x-values.description: A number of one entity class (`…_EntityClass`).
A number of entities out of a list (`…_EntityClasses`).
A mission item the game creates for the mission (`HaulingOrderContent_MissionItem`).

HaulingOrder.description: What a contract has to haul, as one level of the contract states it.

requirements.description:
What has to be hauled, all of it. A requirement with several `options` is satisfied by any
one of them.

variableName.description:
The `missionVariableName` of the `MissionPropertyValue_HaulingOrders` property of a
`property` order; `null` for an `objective` order.

HaulingRequirement.description:
One requirement of a hauling order: the alternatives of which one is hauled. Most
requirements have exactly one option.

options.description: The alternatives; each is a list of items that are all hauled.

HaulingSettings.description:
The `Hauling_ObjectiveSettings` of a hauling handler: the extended text tokens and the display
info of each way the objective is phrased.

HaulingSource.description:
The level of the contract that states a hauling order. Of the property levels the nearest one
wins per `variableName`; the objective orders are those of the template, else of the broker
entry.

x-values.description: A hauling orders property in the overrides of the sub contract.
A hauling orders property in the overrides of the contract.
A hauling orders property in the parameters of the handler.
A hauling orders property in the `contractProperties` of the template.
An order of a hauling objective of the template.
An order of a hauling objective of the `MissionBrokerEntry`.

Ingredient.description: One ingredient line of a blueprint: a resource or an item with its quantity.

itemGuid.description: The GUID of the entity of an item line, `null` for a resource line.

minQuality.description: The minimum quality the ingredient must have, `null` without one.

quantityScu.description: The quantity of a resource line in standard cargo units (SCU), `null` for an item line.

quantityUnits.description: The quantity of an item line in units, `null` for a resource line.

resourceGuid.description: The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record of a resource line, `null` for an item line.

slot.description: The debug name of the slot the ingredient fills, `null` without one.

slotKey.description: The localisation key of the slot name, `null` without one or for a placeholder.

InstanceLimits.description: How many instances of an entry run and for how long.

Item.description: An item: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/scitem` or `entities/legacyitems`.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `POWR_ACAS_S01_Lumen`.

displayType.description: The display type of the purchasable parameters, e.g. `@item_DisplayType_PowerPlant`.

itemClass.description:
The item class from the `Class:` line of the English description, `null` for another
value or without that line. Today one of `Civilian`, `Competition`, `Industrial`,
`Military` and `Stealth`; the schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

manufacturerGuid.description:
The GUID of the manufacturer the Reference `AttachDef.Manufacturer` links to, `null` for
a null Reference.

mass.description: The mass in kilograms of the physics controller, `null` without one.

name.description: The name, from `AttachDef.Localization.Name`.

playability.description:
Who the item is for, `null` when no rule applies. Today one of `player`, `mission` and
`special`; the schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

stats.description:
The typed stat blocks of a weapon, shield, quantum drive, power plant, cooler or missile,
raw facts without derived values (ADR-0065); `null` for any other item.

subType.description: The item subtype of `AttachDef.SubType`, e.g. `Power`, `null` without one.

tags.description: The words of `AttachDef.Tags`, in stored order.

type.description: The item type of `AttachDef.Type`, e.g. `PowerPlant`, `null` without one.

variantOf.description:
The GUID of the base of the variant group the item belongs to, `null` for a base and for an
item that is alone in its group. It is the `guid` of an entry of `items`.

ItemRecovery.description:
The item recovery rules: an `ItemRecoveryConfigurationParams` Record, its `economyParams`.

The multipliers and rates of the Record under their data names. The Record holds no fee in
aUEC, so the catalog states none. Every number is that of the Record, `null` when the Record
states none or a value that is no number.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `GlobalItemRecovery`.

overrides.description:
The `overrides`: groups of entity classes whose multipliers replace the defaults, in the
order of the Record.

ItemStats.description:
The typed stat blocks of an item, raw facts of the Archive (ADR-0065, ADR-0072).

Every block is `null` for an item that does not have it; the item has `stats` only when it
has at least one block: `weapon`, `shield`, `quantumDrive`, `powerPlant`, `cooler`, `missile`,
`armor`, `clothing`, `radar`, `tractorBeam`, `weaponModifier`, `miningLaser` or
`miningModifier`. No value is derived: a number is what the Archive states, in the unit the
game stores it; a value that is not a finite number is `null`.

cooler.description: The cooler block, for an item of the type `Cooler`.

miningLaser.description:
The mining laser block, from `SEntityComponentMiningLaserParams`: ship lasers and the FPS
mining tool.

miningModifier.description:
The mining module or gadget block, from the `EntityComponentAttachableModifierParams` that
holds a mining modifier.

powerPlant.description: The power plant block, for an item of the type `PowerPlant`.

resourceStates.description: The states of `ItemResourceComponentParams` in stored order: signatures and resource flows.

tractorBeam.description: The tractor beam block, from the `SWeaponActionFireTractorBeamParams` of the weapon.

weaponModifier.description:
The tractor and salvage multipliers of an attachment, from
`EntityComponentAttachableModifierParams`.

KindCompleteness.description: Whether a kind holds every Record of the Build or only those a Filter selected.

oneOf.description: Every Record of the kind is listed; one missing from the catalog was removed from the game.
Only the Records the Filter selected are listed.

LegacyLootArchetype.description:
An older loot archetype: a `LootArchetype` Record under `lootgeneration/lootarchetypes`, the
weighted tags of item a table entry stands for.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `LootArchetype_Antiques_Common`.

entries.description: The entries of `primaryOrGroup` in stored order.

excludedTagGuids.description: The `Tag` Records in `excludedTags`: items that carry one are never drawn.

secondaryGroups.description: The groups of `secondaryOrGroups` in stored order.

LegacyLootEntry.description: One entry of the primary group of an older archetype.

name.description: The designer's label of the entry.

spawnWith.description: The `EntryOptionalData_SpawnWith` items spawned along with the entry, in stored order.

tagGuid.description: The `Tag` Record the entry draws items by.

weight.description: The `weight` of the entry among the entries of the group.

LegacyLootTable.description:
An older loot table: a `LootTable` Record under `lootgeneration/loottables`. The `lootTable`
of a slot's `lootConfig` links to one.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Ammo`.

entries.description: The entries of `lootArchetypes` in stored order.

LegacyLootTableEntry.description: One entry of an older loot table: an archetype and the odds it is drawn.

archetypeGuid.description: The `LootArchetype` Record the entry links to, an entry of `legacyLootArchetypes`.

weight.description: The `weight` of the entry among the entries of the table.

LegacySecondaryEntry.description: One entry of a secondary group.

weight.description: The `weight` of the entry among the entries of the group.

LegacySecondaryGroup.description: A secondary group of an older archetype (`LootArchetypeOrGroup_Secondary`).

entries.description: The entries of the group in stored order.

LegacySpawnWith.description: Items an older entry spawns along with its own (`EntryOptionalData_SpawnWith`).

max.description: `max`, how many are spawned at most.

min.description: `min`, how many are spawned at least.

name.description: The designer's label.

LicenseType.description: The licence a `LawLicense` modifier asks for. A value the catalog does not know is `null`.

LinkedOutput.description: The output property an input property takes the value of.

objectiveId.description:
The `id` of the objective that holds the output, an entry of `objectives`; `null` when the
pointer does not name one.

Loadout.description: The ports of a ship or of an item that has ports, and what the Default Loadout puts into them.

entityGuid.description:
The `guid` of the entry in `ships` or `items` the ports belong to; loadouts are ordered by
it.

entityKind.description:
Which kind `entityGuid` is an entry of, `ship` or `item`; a closed set the game may
extend, so the schema keeps a string.

issues.description:
The codes of the problems that kept part of the Loadout from being read, e.g.
`xml_loadout`, sorted and without duplicates; empty when everything was read.

ports.description:
The ports of the Entity: those a Loadout names in Loadout order, then the other defined
ports in definition order, then the item ports of the vehicle implementation no Record
port names.

LoadoutPort.description: One item port and what the Default Loadout attaches to it.

displayNameKey.description: The localisation key of the port's display name; `null` for none or a placeholder key.

dockedVehicle.description:
Whether the attached Entity is a docked vehicle, e.g. a snub craft in a hangar port. Its
ports are not listed.

flags.description:
The flags of the port as stored, split at white space, without a leading `$`, e.g.
`invisible`, `uneditable`.

itemClassName.description:
The class name of the attached Entity, or the class name the Loadout names; `null` for an
empty port or an unresolved Reference.

itemGuid.description:
The `guid` of the entry in `items` (or, for a docked vehicle, in `ships`) the port holds
by default; `null` for an empty port. For an attachment that cannot be resolved it is the
GUID the Loadout names, which may belong to no entry, or `null` when the Loadout names a
class name only.

maxSize.description: The largest item size the port takes, `null` when the data gives none.

minSize.description: The smallest item size the port takes, `null` when the data gives none.

name.description: The port name, as the Loadout or the port definition spells it.

portTags.description:
The tags the port offers: the words of the stored value, split at white space and
otherwise unchanged, like `tags` of an item.

ports.description:
The ports of the attached Entity under this Loadout, or the ports of the nested Loadout of
an empty port; empty for a port without either.

requiredTags.description:
The tags an item must carry to fit the port: the words of the stored value, split at white
space and otherwise unchanged, like `tags` of an item.

source.description:
Where the attachment comes from: `loadout` (the Entity's own Default Loadout), `override`
(the Loadout of the entry that attached the Entity), `port_default` (the default item of
the port definition), `unset` (the port is defined and holds nothing) or `vehicle` (the
port is known only from the vehicle implementation and holds nothing). A closed set the
game may extend, so the schema keeps a string.

types.description: The item types the port takes, in stored order; empty when the data names none.

unresolved.description:
The code of the error that kept the attachment from being resolved, e.g.
`dangling_reference` or `unknown_class`; `null` otherwise.

visibility.description:
Whether the port shows its item: `visible` or `invisible` as the vehicle implementation's
part of that name says; without such a part `invisible` when the port definition carries
the flag `invisible`, else `unspecified`. A closed set the game may extend, so the schema
keeps a string.

LocalisedText.description:
A text the game localises: its localisation key and the resolved English and German texts,
as the language's `global.ini` stores them with the escape `\n` decoded to a line feed.

de.description:
The German text, `null` for no key, a placeholder key, or a key the German `global.ini`
lacks or holds empty.

en.description:
The English text, `null` for no key, a placeholder key, or a key the English `global.ini`
lacks or holds empty.

key.description: The localisation key, e.g. `@manufacturer_NameACAS`, `null` when it is unknown.

LocationCondition.description: One match condition of a location query (`DataSetMatchCondition_*`), as stored.

oneOf.description: `DataSetMatchCondition_TagSearch`: the location must satisfy one of the terms.
`DataSetMatchCondition_ExcludeProperty`: the location differs from another property's.
`DataSetMatchCondition_PropertyTags`: the tags of another property's location.
A condition of another struct, which the catalog does not read.

LocationCount.description: Whether a location property holds one location or several.

LocationName.description: A string variant of a location template.

tag.description: The tag path of the variant, e.g. `Missions.Text.Name`; `null` when it names none.

LocationOverride.description: A distribution that replaces the default one at a location.

distribution.description: The distribution at the location, `null` when the Record holds none.

locationGuid.description: The GUID of the location Record, `null` for a null Reference.

LocationPrerequisite.description:
A `ContractPrerequisite_LocationProperty`: the contract is offered at the location another
property resolves to.

level.description: The level that states the prerequisite: `handler`, `contract` or `subContract`.

locationLevelType.description: The `locationLevelType` as stored (an enum name), `null` when absent.

variable.description: The `propertyVariableName`, the `variable` of an entry of `locationQueries`.

LocationQuery.description:
A location query of a contract: the tag search the game runs against the
`MissionLocationTemplate` Records when the mission starts. Shared by every contract that
states the same.

conditions.description: The `matchConditions` in stored order; a location satisfies all of them.

failIfMinNotFound.description: The `failIfMinAmountNotFound` flag of a multiple query, `null` for a single one.

guid.description: The identifier of the content (see the catalog documentation); not a GUID of the Archive.

maxLocations.description: The `maxLocationsToFind` of a multiple query, `null` for a single one.

minLocations.description: The `minLocationsToFind` of a multiple query, `null` for a single one.

resourceTags.description: The `resourceTags`: the mission type tags the search is made for.

LocationQueryLink.description: The location query a contract states for a variable.

level.description:
The level that states the property: the first of sub contract, contract, handler and
template.

token.description: The `extendedTextToken` of the property, `null` when empty.

LootArchetype.description:
A loot archetype: a `LootArchetypeV3Record` Record under `lootgeneration/lootarchetypes`, the
weighted kinds of item a table entry stands for.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `V3LootArchetype_Antiques`.

entries.description: The entries of `lootArchetype.entries` in stored order.

LootArchetypeEntry.description: One entry of a loot archetype: which items it selects and the odds it is drawn.

name.description: The designer's label of the entry.

spawnWith.description:
The `ArchetypeOptionalDataV3_SpawnWith` items spawned along with the entry, in stored
order.

stackSize.description: The `stackSize` of the `ArchetypeOptionalDataV3_StackSize` of the entry.

weight.description: The `weight` of the entry among the entries of the archetype.

LootConfig.description: The loot a slot of a harvestable generates (`lootConfig`).

fullness.description: The `fullnessFactorRange` of the constraints: how full the container is filled.

lootTableGuid.description: The `LootTable` Record the config links to, an entry of `legacyLootTables`.

lootTableV3Guid.description: The `LootTableV3Record` the config links to, an entry of `lootTables`.

poolFilterGuid.description: The `PoolFilterRecord` of the constraints, an entry of `lootPoolFilters`.

LootContainer.description:
A container placed with a multi config: an entity that places an object container and carries
a `SubHarvestableMultiConfigRecord`, whose tag points the config fills with harvestables and
their loot. One entry per container, system and starmap object it hangs below.

container.description: The path of the object container the entity places.

entityCount.description:
The number of entities in all `.soc` files of the placed container, 0 for none; `null`
when a file cannot be read or the Archive lacks the container.

multiConfigGuid.description:
The `SubHarvestableMultiConfigRecord` the placing entity carries (`multiConfigRef`), an
entry of `subHarvestableMultiConfigs`.

starmapObjectGuid.description:
The `guid` of the `starmapObjects` entry the walk's root container hangs below; `null` for
none or an object the catalog lacks.

system.description: The star system folder of the system container the walk started in.

tagCounts.description:
How many entities of the placed container carry each tag, summed over its `.soc` files and
ordered by GUID; empty when `entityCount` is `null`. The tags of `tagGuids` of the tagged
configs select the slots.

LootPoolFilter.description:
A pool filter: a `PoolFilterRecord` Record under `lootgeneration/filters`, which items a
container may draw.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `V3PoolFilter_ASDDelving`.

filter.description: The filter of the Record; `null` when it has none.

LootSelector.description:
Which items a loot entry selects: the items that carry every positive tag and none of the
negative ones, or the listed entity classes.

entityClassGuids.description: The GUIDs of the entity classes of a manual entity class list, in stored order.

negativeTagGuids.description: The GUIDs of the `Tag` Records in `negativeTags`, in stored order.

positiveTagGuids.description: The GUIDs of the `Tag` Records in `positiveTags`, in stored order.

selectorType.description:
The struct of the selector as stored, e.g. `LootArchetypeV3Selector_Tags`; informational,
not a selector; `null` when the entry has none.

LootTable.description:
A loot table: a `LootTableV3Record` Record under `lootgeneration/loottables`, the weighted
archetypes a container draws from.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `V3LootTable_Actor_CQC`.

entries.description: The entries of `lootTable.lootArchetypes` in stored order.

LootTableEntry.description: One entry of a loot table: an archetype and the odds it is drawn.

archetype.description: The entries of an archetype written out in place; `null` for a linked one.

archetypeGuid.description:
The `LootArchetypeV3Record` the entry links to; `null` for an archetype written out in
place.

chanceToExist.description: `chanceToExist` of the `LootTableOptionalDataV3_ChanceToExist` of the entry, from 0 to 1.

name.description: The designer's label of the entry.

weight.description: The `weight` of the entry among the entries of the table.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `ACAS` for `SCItemManufacturer.ACAS`.

code.description: The manufacturer code, e.g. `ACAS`, `null` when it cannot be read.

name.description: The name.

MineableComposition.description:
A mineable composition: a `MineableComposition` Record under `mining/rockcompositionpresets`,
the elements one rock or deposit is made of.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Asteroid_CType_Iron`.

depositName.description:
The HUD label of the deposit, from `depositName`. The localisation key and the texts are
game texts.

minimumDistinctElements.description: `minimumDistinctElements`, from 1 to 4 on LIVE; `null` when the Record states none.

parts.description: The parts, from `compositionArray` in stored order.

MineableElement.description:
A mineable element: a `MineableElement` Record under `mining/mineableelements`. Several
elements may link to the same `ResourceType`, so none is picked for a commodity.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `agricium_ore`.

instability.description: `elementInstability`, from 0 to 1000 on LIVE; `null` when the Record states none.

resourceTypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record the Reference `resourceType` links to. It equals a
commodity's `subtypeGuid` only when the catalog has that commodity (20 of the 41 linked
`ResourceType`s on LIVE). `null` for a null or dangling Reference.

MineableEntity.description:
A mineable entity: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/mineable`, one kind of
rock or deposit. Many entities share a composition; a provider preset reaches an entity through
the `entityGuid` of its harvestables. Entities are selected by record path and type alone, so
one without the components below has `null` and empty fields.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `MineableRock_AsteroidLegendary_Quantainium`.

mineableCompositionGuid.description: The GUID of the `MineableComposition` Record `Components[MineableParams]` links to.

miningGlobalParamsGuid.description: The GUID of the `MiningGlobalParams` Record `Components[MineableParams]` links to.

radarContactTypeGuid.description: The GUID of the `RadarContactTypeEntry` Record `radarProperties.contactType` links to.

scanSignature.description:
The scan signature the mining scanner shows, from 3000 to 4900 on LIVE: the slot of
`signatures` that `signatureTypeParams` of the `RadarSystemGlobalParams` Record names
`@hud_scanning_info_rs_signature`. `null` when the Record states no signatures, all of them
are zero, `signatures` has not one number per signature type, or the Archive names no
such slot (a catalog warning says so).

signatures.description:
`radarProperties.baseSignatureParams.signatures` of `Components[SSCSignatureSystemParams]`
in stored order, one number per signature type; a value that is not a finite 32-bit float
is exported as 0. Empty when the Record states none.

MiningEffect.description:
The mining modifiers one `ItemMiningModifierParams` or `ItemMineableRockModifierParams`
applies.

lifetime.description: `modifierLifetime.lifetime`, in seconds; `null` for a modifier that lasts.

MiningGlobalParams.description:
The mining parameters of one kind of miner: a `MiningGlobalParams` Record under `mining`. Each
number is that of the Record, unchanged, and `null` when the Record states none. The effects,
sounds and the default explosion of the Record are not exported.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `miningglobalparamsship`.

wasteResourceTypeGuid.description:
The GUID of the `ResourceType` Record the Reference `wasteResourceType` links to; `null`
for a null Reference.

MiningLaserStats.description:
A mining laser, raw facts of `SEntityComponentMiningLaserParams` (ADR-0262).

The beams are fire modes of `weapon.fireActions`: their `hitType`, `fullDamageRange`,
`zeroDamageRange` and `damagePerSecond`.

throttleMinimum.description: `throttleMinimum`, the lowest throttle as a fraction of 1.

MiningModifierStats.description:
A mining module or gadget, raw facts of the `EntityComponentAttachableModifierParams` that
holds a mining modifier (ADR-0262).

activationMethod.description:
`activationMethod`, e.g. `ActivateOnAttach` for a passive module and `ActivateOnDemand`
for an active module or a gadget. A closed set the game may extend; the schema keeps a
string.

charges.description: `charges`; -1 for a gadget that is not used up.

fireActionModifiers.description: The `ItemWeaponModifiersParams` in stored order: the multiplier per fire action.

laser.description: The first `ItemMiningModifierParams`: the change to the laser; `null` without one.

rock.description: The first `ItemMineableRockModifierParams`: the change to the rock; `null` without one.

MiningModifierValues.description:
The modifiers of a `MiningLaserModifiers` struct, each the `value` of a
`FloatModifierMultiplicative` as stored, in percent; `null` for a modifier the struct leaves
unset.

damage.description: The damage of the explosion, from the `damage` of `explosionParams`.

trackingSignalType.description:
`targetingParams.trackingSignalType`. A closed set the game may extend; the schema keeps a
string.

MissionLocality.description:
A mission locality: a `MissionLocality` Record under `missiondata/pu_missionlocality`, a named
set of starmap objects. The game does not localise its name.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `pyro`.

starmapObjectGuids.description:
The `availableLocations`, the `guid`s of entries of `starmapObjects`, in the stored order.
A Reference to no Record is left out; a GUID missing from `starmapObjects` is kept.

MissionLocationTemplate.description:
A mission location template: a `MissionLocationTemplate` Record under
`missiondata/pu_locations`, a place a location query can match by its tags.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `AEGS_Reclaimer_Space_Stanton2c`.

disabled.description: The `disabled` flag of the location data, `null` when absent.

names.description:
The `stringVariants`: the texts the location offers a mission, each under the tag that
names its use.

tags.description: The `generalTags`: what the queries of `contractLocationQueries` match.

MissionReward.description: The `missionReward` of an entry, as stored.

MissionType.description: A mission type: a `MissionType` Record under `missiontype`.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `missiontype.job`.

guid.description: The GUID of the Record, the target of `contracts[].missionTypeGuid`.

typeName.description: The localised name of the type (`LocalisedTypeName`).

Month.description: A calendar month of an availability schedule.

NavPoint.description: The `navPointSpawnInfo` of a handler: the entity the game spawns as the marker.

NpcSpawnGroup.description: A group of NPCs that spawn together (`SpawnDescription_NPC_Group`).

name.description: The `Name` of the group, `null` when empty.

NpcSpawnOption.description: One alternative of an NPC group (`SpawnDescription_NPCOption`): the game spawns one of them.

namePropertyVariable.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `nameProperty` points to, `null` when absent.

weight.description: The `weight` of the alternative among its group; `null` when absent.

NpcSpawnPool.description:
An NPC spawn description of a contract: what a `MissionPropertyValue_NPCSpawnDescriptions`
property states, shared by every contract that states the same.

guid.description: The identifier of the content (see the catalog documentation); not a GUID of the Archive.

NumberOption.description: An option of an integer or float property.

dependentProperties.description: The `missionVariableName` of the properties the option makes dependent.

variation.description: The `variation` the game applies around the value, as stored.

weighting.description: The `weighting` of the option among the others.

ObjectiveCategory.description: The category of an objective display. A value the catalog does not know is `null`.

communicationTag.description: The tag path of the `communicationTags` tag.

trigger.description: The state of the objective that triggers the message.

ObjectiveDisplay.description:
The display info of an objective or of one of its sub objectives: the texts and flags as
stored.

category.description: The `category`; `null` when absent or a value the catalog does not know.

ObjectiveHandler.description:
An objective handler: the struct and the settings its fields hold. A field the struct does not
have is `null`; the orders of a hauling handler are `haulingOrders` of the template.

haulingLimitProperty.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `haulingLimitProperty` points to.

hideMarkers.description: The `hideMarkers` flag of a hauling handler.

locationProperty.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `location` points to.

module.description: The `module` file of the mission scripting, `null` when empty.

organizationProperty.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `organization` points to.

targetProperty.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `targetObject` points to.

ObjectiveProperty.description: A property of an objective token.

contractProperty.description:
The `missionVariableName` of the property of the template the `property` of a referenced
property points to; `null` for any other kind or a pointer to nothing.

kind.description: How the objective holds the property.

linkedOutput.description: The output an input property takes, `null` for any other kind.

token.description: The `extendedTextToken` of the property, `null` when empty.

value.description: The value of an output, embedded or input property, `null` for a referenced one.

variable.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property, `null` when empty.

ObjectiveState.description:
The state of an objective token or of the mission, as the mission flow, the comms
notifications and the flow actions name it. A value the catalog does not know is `null`.

OfferedAt.description: Everywhere a contract is offered, as its prerequisites state it and without a cap.

brokerFallback.description:
Whether `locations` is the location of the broker entry because the contract's
prerequisites state no place, not a location the prerequisites state.

localityGuids.description:
The `MissionLocality` Records of the `ContractPrerequisite_Locality` prerequisites, the
`guid`s of entries of `missionLocalities`, in stored order, none twice. A locality names
its places through `starmapObjectGuids`.

locations.description:
The objects of the `ContractPrerequisite_Location` prerequisites, in stored order, none
twice, a star and an object that is not in `starmapObjects` included (its `objectType` and
`place` are then `null`). When the contract states no place at all, the
`locationMissionAvailable` of its `MissionBrokerEntry`, and `brokerFallback` is `true`.

OverrideDisplay.description: The title and description an objective overrides in the mission details.

Paint.description: A paint: an item of the type `Paints` and the ships it fits.

itemGuid.description: The `guid` of the paint's entry in `items`, which holds its name and record.

shipGuids.description:
The GUIDs of the ships the paint fits, ordered by GUID; empty when it fits none. Each
is the `guid` of an entry of `ships`.

PartialPayout.description:
The `PartialContractRewards` of a template: what an abandoned or partly completed contract
still pays.

PayoutRange.description: A `PartialContractRewardRange`: the share of the reward paid between two completion percentages.

currencyRewardMultiplier.description: The `currencyRewardMultiplier` applied to the payout, as stored.

maxPercentage.description: The `maxPercentage` of the contract that is completed.

minPercentage.description: The `minPercentage` of the contract that is completed.

reputationRewardMultiplier.description: The `reputationRewardMultiplier` applied to the gain in that scope, as stored.

PickupPlace.description: A place a contract is picked up at: an object of the starmap.

objectType.description: The type of the starmap object, e.g. `Planet`.

place.description: The name of the place, as the starmap object states it.

PoolEntry.description: One entry of a blueprint pool.

blueprintGuid.description: The GUID of the blueprint, `null` for a null Reference.

weight.description: The weight of the entry among the pool's, `null` when the Record holds none.

PoolFilterInstance.description: One filter of a sequence and how it combines with the ones before it.

filter.description: The filter; `null` when the instance has none.

name.description: The designer's label.

PoolFilterNode.description:
One node of a pool filter: a sequence of filters, a link to another filter Record, or a tag
term.

filters.description: The filters of a `PoolFilter_Sequence`, in stored order.

negativeTagGuids.description: The GUIDs of the `Tag` Records in `negativeTags` of a `PoolFilter_Tags`.

nodeType.description:
The struct of the node as stored, e.g. `PoolFilter_Sequence`; informational, not a
selector: the other fields tell what the node holds.

positiveTagGuids.description: The GUIDs of the `Tag` Records in `positiveTags` of a `PoolFilter_Tags`.

PortType.description: An item type a port takes.

subTypes.description:
The item subtypes the port takes; empty when it takes every subtype or the data gives
none.

powerOutput.description: The `amount` of the first `generation` flow of `resourceStates` whose resource is `Power`.

PropertyKind.description:
How an objective holds a mission property (`ObjectiveProperty_*`). A struct the catalog does
not know is `null`.

x-values.description: The objective refers to a property of the template's `contractProperties`.
The objective holds the property itself.
The objective takes the output of another objective's property.

PropertyModifier.description: A gameplay property of the crafted item with the ranges that scale it by quality.

propertyGuid.description: The GUID of the `gameplayProperties` entry, `null` for a null Reference.

PropertyValue.description: The value of a mission property (`MissionPropertyValue_*`), tagged by `type`.

oneOf.description: `MissionPropertyValue_Object`: an object the mission scripting provides.
`MissionPropertyValue_DeliveryOrder`: a delivery order the mission scripting provides.

poolGuid.description:
The `guid` of the entry of `contractShipSpawns`; `null` for a description without a
group.

The `guid` of the entry of `contractNpcSpawns`; `null` for a description without a
group.

The `guid` of the entry of `contractEntitySpawns`; `null` for a description without a
group.

oneOf.description: `MissionPropertyValue_Organization`: the organisations a mission may pick from.

conditions.description: The `matchConditions`, as for a location query.

oneOf.description: `MissionPropertyValue_MissionItem`: the mission items a mission may pick from.

conditions.description: The `matchConditions`, as for a location query.

oneOf.description:
`MissionPropertyValue_CombinedDataSetEntries`: the properties whose data set entries the
mission combines.

entryProperties.description:
The `missionVariableName` of the properties of `dataSetEntryProperties`, in stored
order.

oneOf.description: `MissionPropertyValue_HaulingOrders`: what the mission hauls, as in `haulingOrders`.
`MissionPropertyValue_TimeTrialRace`: a race the mission scripting provides.
`MissionPropertyValue_StarMapLocation`: a star map location the mission scripting provides.

kind.description:
The struct of the distribution, e.g. `CraftingQualityDistributionNormal`. A closed set the
game may extend.

QualityDistribution.description:
A quality distribution Record under `crafting/qualitydistribution`: the default distribution
of a source or the list of its location overrides.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

distribution.description: The distribution of a `CraftingQualityDistributionRecord`, `null` for an override Record.

overrides.description: The overrides of a `CraftingQualityLocationOverrideRecord`, empty for a default Record.

QualityQuantization.description:
A quality quantization: a `CraftingQualityQuantizationRecord` under
`crafting/qualityquantization`, the quantised quality steps of the `ResourceType`s that link to
it. The Record itself holds no link to a `ResourceType`; the link goes the other way, so
`resourceTypeGuids` is derived from the `ResourceType` Records.

bands.description: The bands in stored order, 8 on LIVE and the same ranges for every Record.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Quantization_Gold`.

resourceTypeGuids.description:
The GUIDs of the `ResourceType` Records whose crafting data link to the Record, ordered by
GUID. It equals a commodity's `subtypeGuid` only when the catalog has that commodity.
Empty for a Record no `ResourceType` uses.

QuantityRange.description: A range of amounts, both ends included.

QuantizationBand.description:
One band of a quality quantization: every quality from `start` to `end` counts as
`mappedValue`.

end.description: The highest quality of the band, inclusive, 399 to 1000 on LIVE.
