mappedValue.description: The quality the game uses for every quality in the band, 0 to 1000 on LIVE.

start.description: The lowest quality of the band, 0 to 999 on LIVE.

objectiveId.description: The `objective`, an entry of `objectives`; `null` when it points to none.

Reaction.description:
How a faction reacts to the other in a `FactionHostility` modifier. A value the catalog does
not know is `null`.

RecoveryOverride.description: An `ItemRecoveryOverrideGroupDef`: the multipliers of a group of entity classes.

classGuids.description:
The GUIDs of the entity classes the group applies to (`classes`), in the order of the
Record. Each is the GUID of an `EntityClassDefinition` Record, an entry of `ships` for a
ship; a Reference to no Record reads as null and is left out.

RefiningProcess.description:
A refining process: a `RefiningProcess` Record under `refiningprocess`, one method of a
refinery. The DataForge holds no yields.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `processingtype-fastcareful`.

processName.description:
The name of the method, from `processName`. The localisation key and the texts are game
texts.

refiningQuality.description:
`refiningQuality`, one of `Wasteful`, `Normal` and `Careful` on LIVE; `null` when the Record
states none. The schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

refiningSpeed.description:
`refiningSpeed`, one of `Slow`, `Normal` and `Fast` on LIVE; `null` when the Record states
none. The schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

RelationStanding.description: The scope and standing a faction relation assigns.

scopeGuid.description: The `SReputationScopeParams` Record, `null` when the relation names none.

standingGuid.description: The `SReputationStandingParams` Record, `null` when the relation names none.

x-values.description: The window repeats every year until the repeat end (`RepeatYearly`).

ReputationAmount.description: A reputation amount an entry grants.

amount.description: The `reputationAmount` of the reward Record; `null` when it cannot be read.

rewardGuid.description: The reward Record the amount is read from.

ReputationContext.description:
A reputation context: an `SReputationContextUI` Record under `reputation/contexts`, the scopes a
faction is shown with.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `ReputationContext_Transport`.

primaryScopeGuid.description: The scope of the `primaryScopeContext`, `null` when it names none.

scopeGuids.description: The scopes of the `scopeContextList`, in the stored order.

ReputationGain.description: One reputation amount a contract grants on success.

amount.description: The `reputationAmount` of the reward Record, `null` when it cannot be read.

factionReputationGuid.description: The GUID of the faction reputation Record, `null` when the result names none.

factionReputationName.description: The Record name of the faction reputation, `null` when the result names none.

scopeGuid.description: The GUID of the reputation scope Record, `null` when the result names none.

scopeName.description:
The Record name of the reputation scope, e.g. the faction or the affinity scope, `null`
when the result names none.

ReputationResult.description:
One element of `missionResultReputationRewards`: the amounts granted for one result of the
mission.

index.description: The position in the stored array; the Archive names no result.

ReputationScope.description:
A reputation scope: an `SReputationScopeParams` Record under `reputation/scopes`, the ladder of
standings one kind of reputation climbs.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `ReputationScope_Affinity`.

initialReputation.description: The reputation a player starts with (`initialReputation`).

reputationCeiling.description: The highest reputation of the scope (`reputationCeiling`).

standingGuids.description: The standings of the scope, in the stored order.

ReputationStanding.description:
A reputation standing: an `SReputationStandingParams` Record under `reputation/standings`, one
rank of a scope.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `ReputationStanding_Faction_B2_00`.

displayName.description: The `displayName`, the name of the rank.

driftReputation.description: The reputation the standing drifts back by (`driftReputation`).

minReputation.description: The reputation from which the standing applies (`minReputation`).

RequiredIntro.description: A completion tag a contract requires and the intro contracts that grant it.

introContracts.description:
The `id` of every intro contract (an element of `introContracts` of a handler) whose success
result grants the tag, ordered by `id`; empty when none does.

tagGuid.description: The `Tag` Record the prerequisite requires among the completed contracts.

ResistanceEntry.description:
The resistance to one damage type, as stored: the multiplier is the factor damage is scaled
by, not a mitigation.

ResourceFlow.description: One generation or consumption of a resource, per second, in the unit the Archive states.

amount.description: The first number of `resourceAmountPerSecond`, in the unit named by `unit`.

direction.description: `generation` or `consumption`: the field of the delta that holds the flow.

kind.description:
The struct of the delta, e.g. `ItemResourceDeltaGeneration`. A closed set the game may
extend; the schema keeps a string.

resource.description: The `resource`, e.g. `Power`. A closed set the game may extend; the schema keeps a string.

unit.description:
The struct that holds the amount, e.g. `SPowerSegmentResourceUnit`; the units of two
structs differ and are not converted.

ResourceGroup.description:
A resource group: a `ResourceTypeGroup` Record under `resourcetypedatabase`, the type the
`typeGuid` of a commodity points at.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Metal`.

name.description: The name, from `displayName`; a placeholder key leaves `en` and `de` `null`.

parentGuid.description:
The GUID of the group that lists this group in its `groups`, the `guid` of another
`resourceGroups` entry; `null` for a top-level group. It is the direct parent: the groups
form a forest of unfixed depth, so follow it with a guard against cycles.

ResourceState.description: One state of the resource component: its signatures and the resources it generates and uses.

flows.description: The `generation` and `consumption` of the state's `deltas`, in stored order.

name.description: The `name` of the state, e.g. `Online`.

RewardContribution.description: The `rewardContribution` of an objective: how much of the reward it stands for.

RewardSource.description:
A place that rewards a blueprint of a pool with a chance: a `BlueprintRewards` result of a
contract.

chance.description:
The chance that the reward is given as the Record states it, 0 to 1 on LIVE and not
clamped, `null` when the Record holds none.

contractId.description: The `id` of the nearest enclosing struct that has one, e.g. the contract.

recordGuid.description: The GUID of the Record that holds the reward.

recordPath.description: The record path of that Record, without `.xml`.

ScenarioFactionTiers.description: The reward tiers of one faction in a scenario.

factionGuid.description:
The GUID of the `Faction` Record, `null` for a null or dangling Reference. No kind lists
`Faction` Records; `factionReputationGuid` is the link into the catalog.

factionName.description:
The Record name of the faction, the last part of its record path, e.g.
`faction_lawful_crusaderindustries`; `null` for no Reference.

factionReputationGuid.description:
The `factionReputationRef` of the `Faction` Record, an entry of `factionReputations`;
`null` when the Record is missing, unreadable or names none.

pointsAsPercent.description: Whether the tier points count as percent (`convertTiersPointsToPercent`).

progressions.description: The progressions (`tierProgressions`), in the stored order.

ScenarioProgression.description: One progression of a scenario: a ladder of tiers.

completionType.description: The struct name of the `completionType`, e.g. `CompletionType_GlobalProgression`.

periodScenarioGuid.description: The `periodMissionScenario` Record, `null` when it names none.

tiers.description: The tiers (`tierRewards`), in the stored order.

ScenarioTier.description: A reward tier of a scenario progression.

badgeToAward.description:
The identifier of the badge the tier awards (`badgeToAward`), `null` for none; the game
stores the text `None` for a tier without a badge.

blueprintPoolGuids.description:
The blueprint pools the tier rewards (`blueprintPool`), the `guid`s of entries of
`blueprintPools`, in the stored order.

minPoints.description: The points from which the tier is reached (`minPoints`).

ScheduleMoment.description: A date and time of day as stored; a part the Record does not state is `null`.

ScheduleWindow.description: A window an entry is offered in (`availableDateSchedule`).

repeatEnd.description: The `repeatEnd`: the date after which the window no longer repeats; no time of day.

Ship.description:
A ship or ground vehicle: an `EntityClassDefinition` Record under `entities/spaceships` or
`entities/groundvehicles`.

cargoGridsWithIssue.description:
How many cargo grids of the default Loadout have no readable capacity, e.g. because their
container Record does not exist.

cargoScu.description:
The cargo capacity in standard cargo units (SCU) of the cargo grids the default Loadout
reaches, rounded to four decimals: 0 for a ship without a cargo grid, `null` when it has
grids and none can be read. With `cargoGridsWithIssue` above 0 the value is a lower bound.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `AEGS_Avenger_Titan`.

description.description: The description, from `vehicleDescription` of the vehicle parameters.

hullHealth.description:
The hull hit points: the sum of the positive `damageMax` of the structural parts of the
vehicle implementation, rounded to four decimals. `null` without a vehicle implementation
or when no part states a `damageMax`.

insurance.description:
The claim and expedite values of the ship's `SEntityInsuranceProperties`; `null` when the
Record has none.

manufacturerGuid.description:
The GUID of the manufacturer the Reference `manufacturer` links to, `null` for a null
Reference.

mass.description:
The hull mass in kilograms, without the Loadout, the docked vehicles and the landing gear:
the sum of the `mass` of the parts of the vehicle implementation after the Modification
the ship selects, rounded to four decimals. `null` when neither the parts nor the physics
controller state one, never 0.

massBasis.description:
What `mass` is the sum of. Today one of `parts` and `physics`; the schema keeps a string,
as a new value is additive. `null` exactly when `mass` is.

name.description: The name, from `vehicleName` of the vehicle parameters.

playability.description:
Who the ship is for, `null` when no rule applies. Today one of `player`, `ai`, `mission`
and `special`; the schema keeps a string, as a new value is additive.

size.description: The item size of `AttachDef.Size`, `null` without one.

variantOf.description:
The GUID of the base of the variant group the ship belongs to: the ships that share the
vehicle definition and the vehicle implementation after the Modification. `null` for a base
and for a ship that is alone in its group. It is the `guid` of an entry of `ships`.

vehicleDefinition.description: The path of the vehicle definition XML, `null` without one.

vehicleKind.description:
Spaceship or ground vehicle, `null` when the record path and the vehicle implementation
do not settle it. Today one of `spaceship` and `groundVehicle`; the schema keeps a string,
as a new value is additive.

ShipInsurance.description:
The insurance data of a ship: the `SEntityInsuranceProperties` of its
`StaticEntityClassData`, the numbers of its `ShipInsuranceParams`. The Record states no claim
cost; `expediteFee` is the only fee in aUEC.

baseWaitTimeMinutes.description:
`baseWaitTimeMinutes` in minutes; inferred meaning: the claim time. `null` when the Record
states none.

expediteFee.description:
`baseExpeditingFee` of the Record in aUEC, the only fee in the Record; `null` when the
Record states none.

mandatoryWaitTimeMinutes.description:
`mandatoryWaitTimeMinutes` in minutes; inferred meaning: the shortest claim time. `null`
when the Record states none.

restoreOnClaim.description:
`restoreOnClaim`, a boolean; inferred meaning: whether a claim restores the ship with its
Loadout. `null` when the Record states none.

shipEntityClassName.description:
`shipEntityClassName` of the insurance parameters, e.g. `AEGS_Gladius`; `null` when it is
empty.

ShipSpawnGroup.description: A group of ships that spawn together (`SpawnDescription_ShipGroup`).

name.description: The `Name` of the group, `null` when empty.

slots.description: The ships of the group, one slot each.

ShipSpawnOption.description: One alternative of a ship slot: a ship the game picks by tags.

concurrentAmount.description: The `concurrentAmount`: how many of the ship are alive at once; `null` when absent.

namePropertyVariable.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `nameProperty` points to, `null` when absent.

negativeTags.description: The `negativeTags` a match must not carry.

tags.description:
The `tags` the game searches ships and crew by: ship model, role, faction, cargo, spawn
flags.

weight.description: The `weight` of the alternative among its slot; `null` when absent.

ShipSpawnPool.description:
A ship spawn description of a contract: what a `MissionPropertyValue_ShipSpawnDescriptions`
property states, shared by every contract that states the same.

guid.description: The identifier of the content (see the catalog documentation); not a GUID of the Archive.

ShipSpawnSlot.description: The alternatives for one ship (`SpawnDescription_ShipOptions`): the game spawns one of them.

ShipStoreSlug.description: An RSI store slug and the ship it stands for.

className.description: The `className` of the ship the slug maps to, `null` for a retired slug.

retired.description:
Whether the slug's ship no longer exists in the game data; the slug stays so that a
pledge of it is recognised as retired.

rsiId.description: The ship id of the RSI store.

shipGuid.description: The `guid` of the ship of `ships` the slug maps to, `null` for a retired slug.

slug.description:
The slug of the ship in the RSI store, the last segment of its pledge URL, e.g.
`Aurora-Mk-I-ES`; entries are ordered by it.

storeName.description: The ship name as the RSI store shows it.

Shop.description:
A shop: one `ShopBackup` entry of the shop registry `Data\Libs\CosmoTools\LayerRecovery\
LayerBackups.xml`, one placement of an `SCShop` Entity in the world. No prices and no stock; the
item GUIDs come only from an inventory file that the shop containers name (ADR-0071).

body.description:
The second container, the body or jump point the shop is below (e.g.
`OOC_Stanton_4_Microtech`, `pyro5`); `null` when the chain has none.

commodityExchange.description:
Whether the shop is a commodity exchange or commodity terminal: `entityName` starts with
`SCShop_CommEx_TDD_`, or starts with `SCShop_Platinumbay` and ends with `_Commodity`.

containers.description:
The names of the containers from the system root down to the one that holds the shop,
from the `SuperName` chain without its GUIDs and without the `SCShop` Entity.

defaultValue.description:
The `DefaultValue` GUID of the registry entry; `null` when it is empty. Shops with the same
`registryName` share it.

entityGuid.description:
The `CryGUID` of the `SCShop` Entity, the last element of `key`. A shop module placed in
several places keeps it, so it is no identity; it is the `CryGUID` the container's
`entitycomponentshop.xml` names.

entityName.description:
The name of the `SCShop` Entity, the last element of the registry's `SuperName`, e.g.
`SCShop_CommEx_TDD_NewBabbage`. An internal name, not a localisation key.

inventory.description:
The lower-case file stem of `Data\Scripts\ShopInventories\<stem>.json` that the `.soc` of
every shop container naming `entityGuid` gives the `SCShop` component (ADR-0071); `null`
when no container names a file, the containers disagree or the file is missing or
unreadable.

itemGuids.description:
The `EntityClassDefinition` GUIDs of the items in that inventory file, lower case, ordered
and without repeats; `null` exactly when `inventory` is. No price, stock or rental data.

key.description:
The identity: the `ID` chain of the registry entry, the `CryGUID`s of the containers from
the system root down to the `SCShop` Entity, comma separated. Unique in the catalog.

kind.description:
The kind from the path of the shop container whose `SCShop` Entity is `entityGuid`:
the folder below `PU\Shops` (e.g. `commex`, `clothing`), or `shopcomm` or `shopfood` for a
container below `PU\loc`. A closed set the game may extend; `null` when no container or
containers of different kinds hold the Entity.

location.description:
The third container, the location (e.g. `Area18_City_objectContainer`); `null` when the
chain has none.

registryName.description:
The `ShopName` of the registry entry, e.g. `Pharmacy_RestStop_ARC-LEO1`; `null` when it is
empty. An internal name, not a localisation key. Many shops share one.

starmapObjectGuid.description:
The `guid` of the `starmapObjects` entry whose `entityName` or `className` equals
`location` ignoring ASCII case; `null` when none does or more than one object does.

system.description:
The star system whose registry holds the shop: the platform name without the suffix
`system`, e.g. `stanton`, `pyro`.

archiveModified.description: The modification time of the Archive file, UTC in RFC 3339 form, `null` when unknown.

archiveSize.description: The size of the Archive file in bytes.

build.description: The Build from the Channel's build manifest, `null` when it is unknown.

channel.description: The Channel: the name of the folder holding the Archive, `null` when there is none.

exportedAt.description: When the catalog was written, UTC in RFC 3339 form.

toolVersion.description: The version of P4KX that wrote the catalog.

SpawnLevel.description: The level of a contract that states a property or a prerequisite.

x-values.description: The overrides of the sub contract.

SpawnPoolLink.description: The ship, NPC or entity spawn description a contract states for a variable.

level.description:
The level that states the property: the first of sub contract, contract, handler and
template.

poolGuid.description:
The `guid` of the entry of `contractShipSpawns`, `contractNpcSpawns` or
`contractEntitySpawns`, by the field the link is in.

token.description: The `extendedTextToken` of the property, `null` when empty.

SpawnWith.description: Items an entry spawns along with its own (`ArchetypeOptionalDataV3_SpawnWith`).

name.description: The designer's label.

Spread.description: The spread of a fire mode, as stored in `SSpreadParams`.

StandingLevel.description: The level at which a prerequisite is stated.

StandingRequirement.description: A reputation prerequisite of a contract.

exclude.description: The `exclude` flag as stored, `null` when absent.

factionReputationGuid.description: The `factionReputation` the prerequisite is about, `null` when it names none.

maxStandingGuid.description: The `maxStanding`, `null` when the prerequisite names none.

minStandingGuid.description: The `minStanding`, `null` when the prerequisite names none.

scopeGuid.description: The `scope`, `null` when the prerequisite names none.

StandingTerm.description:
One element of the reputation requirement expression of an entry, in stored order, tagged by
`type`. The elements form an infix expression: requirements joined by `and`, grouped by
parentheses.

oneOf.description:
`SReputationMissionGiverRequirementParams`: the standing in a scope of a faction compared
with a named standing.

StarmapObject.description:
A starmap object: a `StarMapObject` Record under `starmap/pu`, a star system, planet, moon,
station, jump point or other place, with its world position when a system container places it.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `Stanton1_Hurston`.

entityName.description:
The `entityName` of the Child element that places the object, e.g. `jumppoint_stanton_pyro`;
`null` when it is not placed or the Child names none.

hideInStarmap.description:
Whether the starmap hides the object, from `hideInStarmap`; `null` when the Record states
none.

name.description:
The name of the place, from `name` of the Record. The localisation key and the texts are
game texts.

parentGuid.description:
The GUID of the object the Reference `parent` links to, `null` for a null Reference. Each
is the `guid` of an entry of `starmapObjects` unless its Record is missing or left out.

placedUnderGuid.description:
The GUID of the nearest object above this one in the container hierarchy, `null` when it
is not placed or hangs directly below the system. Each is a `guid` of `starmapObjects`
unless its Record is missing or left out.

system.description:
The star system that places the object: the folder below `ObjectContainers/PU/system`,
e.g. `stanton`; `null` when no system container places it.

type.description:
The type of the object: the `name` of the `StarMapObjectType` Record the Reference `type`
links to when that is a plain string, else the Record name without its type; `null` for a
null or dangling Reference. The schema keeps a string, as a new type is additive.

typeGuid.description: The GUID the Reference `type` links to, `null` for a null Reference.

StartComms.description: The `contractStartCommsNotification`: the message sent when the contract starts.

communicationTag.description: The tag path of the `communicationTags` tag.

Stated_boolean.description: A value as stored, with the level that states it.

layer.description: The first level of sub contract, contract, handler and template that states the value.

Stated_int64.description: A value as stored, with the level that states it.

layer.description: The first level of sub contract, contract, handler and template that states the value.

StringOption.description: An option of a string hash property.

dependentProperties.description: The `missionVariableName` of the properties the option makes dependent.

weighting.description: The `weighting` of the option among the others.

SubHarvestable.description: One sub harvestable of a config.

geometryTagGuids.description: The GUIDs of the `Tag` Records of `geometries`, in stored order.

harvestable.description: What the sub harvestable spawns; `null` when it names neither a harvestable nor an entity.

lootConfig.description: The loot the slot generates (`lootConfig`); `null` when the slot has none.

setupGuid.description: The GUID of the Record the Reference `harvestableSetup` links to.

SubHarvestableMultiConfig.description:
A sub harvestable multi config: a `SubHarvestableMultiConfigRecord` Record under
`harvestable/slotpresets`, what the slots of an object can hold by tag.

className.description: The Record name without its type.

defaultConfigGuid.description:
The GUID of the Record the default config links to when it is a reference; `null` for none
or a config of another form.

taggedConfigs.description: The configs by tag, from `taggedConfigs` in stored order.

TagCount.description: How many entities carry one tag.

entities.description: The number of entities that carry the tag.

TagTerm.description: The positive and negative tags of a tag search term.

negativeTags.description: The tags a match must not carry.

TaggedConfig.description: One config of a [`SubHarvestableMultiConfig`] and the tags it applies to.

configGuid.description:
The GUID of the Record the config links to when it is a reference; `null` for a config
written out in place.

initialSlotsProbability.description: `initialSlotsProbability` of a config written out in place.

name.description: `name`.

respawnTimeMultiplier.description: `configRespawnTimeMultiplier` of a config written out in place.

subHarvestables.description: The sub harvestables of a config written out in place, in stored order.

tagGuids.description: The GUIDs of the `Tag` Records of the tag list, in stored order.

TemplateModifier.description: A modifier of a template or a broker entry (`MissionModifier_*`), tagged by `modifier`.

locationProperty.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `locationProperty` points to.

itemGuid.description: The `itemRecordGUID`, the ship item that is rented; an entry of `items` or `ships`.

locationProperty.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `locationProperty` points to.
The `missionVariableName` of the property the `locationProperty` points to.

terms.description: The `terms` of the `kioskFilterType`: a ship matches one of them.

factionGuid.description: The `faction` Record, a `Faction`; no kind lists these.

locationProperty.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `locationProperty` points to.

myReaction.description: The `myReaction`: the reaction of the mission giver's faction to `faction`.

theirReaction.description: The `theirReaction`: the reaction of `faction` to the mission giver's faction.

brokerEntryGuid.description: The `missionBrokerEntry` of the hostile mission, an entry of `missionBrokerEntries`.

locationProperty.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `locationProperty` points to.

brokerEntryGuid.description:
The `missionBrokerEntry` whose players' criminality is ignored, an entry of
`missionBrokerEntries`.

locationProperty.description: The `missionVariableName` of the property the `locationProperty` points to.
The `missionVariableName` of the property the `locationProperty` points to.

TemplateObjective.description: An objective token of a template.

id.description: The `id` of the token; unique within the template.

parentId.description: The `id` of the token whose `childMissionPhases` hold this one, `null` at the top level.

phaseTag.description: The tag path of the `missionPhaseIdentifierTag`, `null` when absent.

variableName.description: The `variableName` of a child mission phase, `null` for a top level token.

weight.description: The `weight` of a child mission phase, `null` for a top level token.

TemplateOwner.description: The Record that owns a template: the team or developer that maintains it.

className.description: The Record name without its type, e.g. `MDT`; `null` when the Archive lacks the Record.

TemplateProperty.description: A mission property of a template or broker entry: a variable and the value it holds.

value.description:
The value as for the properties of an objective, tagged by `type`; `null` when the
property has none. Spawn descriptions and location queries are links into the kinds
`contractShipSpawns`, `contractNpcSpawns`, `contractEntitySpawns` and
`contractLocationQueries`.

valueType.description:
The struct of the value without its `MissionPropertyValue_` start, e.g. `Location` or
`ShipSpawnDescriptions`; `null` when the property has no value.

ValueRange.description: One linear range of a modifier: the value at the quality `startQuality` and at `endQuality`.

atEnd.description: The modifier at the end quality, `null` when the Record holds none.

atStart.description: The modifier at the start quality, `null` when the Record holds none.

endQuality.description: The quality the range ends at, `null` when the Record holds none.

kind.description:
`multiplier` when the values are factors, `additive` when they are summands. A closed set;
a reader maps an unknown value to nothing.

startQuality.description: The quality the range starts at, `null` when the Record holds none.

WeaponModifierStats.description:
The tractor and salvage multipliers an attachment applies, from the `weaponStats` of its
`EntityComponentAttachableModifierParams`.

WeaponStats.description: A weapon: its fire modes and the ammunition it fires.

ammo.description:
The ammunition, from the `AmmoParams` Record that `ammoParamsRecord` of that container
links to; `null` without a readable one.

ammoCapacity.description:
`maxAmmoCount` of the ammo container: the weapon's own `SAmmoContainerComponentParams` or,
for a weapon without one, that of the magazine entity `ammoContainerRecord` links to. The
capacity of the magazine, not of the weapon body.

fireActions.description: The fire modes of `fireActions` in stored order; a sequence is flattened to its entries.

description: The Basetool catalog: the game data the basetool's P4K import reads.

blueprintCategories.description: The blueprint categories, ordered by GUID.

blueprintPools.description: The blueprint pools with the places that reward them, ordered by GUID.

cargoManifests.description: The cargo manifests, how the game fills the cargo grid of a spawned ship, ordered by GUID.

completeness.description: Whether each kind is a complete snapshot of the Build.

contractEntitySpawns.description:
The distinct entity spawn descriptions of the contracts, templates and broker entries,
ordered by identifier.

contractLocationQueries.description: The distinct location queries of the contracts, ordered by identifier.

contractNpcSpawns.description:
The distinct NPC spawn descriptions of the contracts, templates and broker entries, ordered
by identifier.

contractScenarios.description: The contract scenarios with their reward tiers, ordered by GUID.

contractShipSpawns.description: The distinct ship spawn descriptions of the contracts, ordered by identifier.

contractTemplates.description: The contract templates, the targets of `contracts[].templateGuid`, ordered by GUID.

contracts.description:
The contracts and sub contracts with resolved titles, mission types and the reputation they
grant on success, ordered by the GUID of the contract and then of the sub contract.

crafters.description: The crafting stations with the limits of their job queues, ordered by GUID.

craftingGlobal.description: The global crafting parameters that apply to every dismantle.

dismantleProcesses.description: The dismantle processes, ordered by GUID.

factionReputations.description: The factions with their reputation links, ordered by GUID.

gameplayProperties.description: The gameplay property definitions the quality modifiers refer to, ordered by GUID.

harvestableLocations.description:
The containers whose `.soc` names a provider preset, with the starmap object they hang
below, ordered by preset GUID, container, system and object GUID.

harvestableProviderPresets.description: The harvestable provider presets, what a place can spawn, ordered by GUID.

itemRecovery.description:
The item recovery rules, the multipliers the game applies to claims, `null` when the
Archive has no such Record. Not a kind.

legacyLootArchetypes.description: The older loot archetypes the older tables draw from, ordered by GUID.

legacyLootTables.description: The older loot tables, the targets of `lootConfig.lootTableGuid`, ordered by GUID.

loadouts.description:
The ports of every ship and of every item that has ports, with what the Default Loadout
attaches to each, ordered by the GUID of the entity.

lootArchetypes.description: The loot archetypes with the weighted selectors of each, ordered by GUID.

lootContainers.description:
The containers placed with a multi config, with the starmap object each hangs below,
ordered by config, container, system and object.

lootPoolFilters.description: The loot pool filters, ordered by GUID.

lootTables.description: The loot tables with the weighted archetypes of each, ordered by GUID.

mineableCompositions.description: The mineable compositions, the elements a rock or deposit is made of, ordered by GUID.

mineableElements.description: The mineable elements, ordered by GUID. Several may link to one `ResourceType`.

mineableEntities.description: The mineable entities with the scan signature of each, ordered by GUID.

miningGlobalParams.description: The mining parameters of each kind of miner, ordered by GUID.

missionBrokerEntries.description: The mission broker entries, the targets of `contracts[].brokerEntryGuid`, ordered by GUID.

missionLocalities.description: The mission localities, sets of starmap objects, ordered by GUID.

missionLocationTemplates.description:
The mission location templates, the places a location query matches by tags, ordered by
GUID.

missionTypes.description: The mission types, the targets of `contracts[].missionTypeGuid`, ordered by GUID.

paints.description: The paints with the ships they fit, ordered by the GUID of the item.

qualityDistributions.description: The quality distributions and their location overrides, ordered by GUID.

qualityQuantizations.description: The quality quantizations, the quantised quality steps per `ResourceType`, ordered by GUID.

refiningProcesses.description: The refining processes, ordered by GUID.

reputationContexts.description: The reputation contexts, the scopes a faction is shown with, ordered by GUID.

reputationScopes.description: The reputation scopes with the standings of each, ordered by GUID.

reputationStandings.description: The reputation standings, the ranks of the scopes, ordered by GUID.

resourceGroups.description: The resource groups, ordered by GUID.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the catalog shape; an import rejects a version it does not know.

shipStoreSlugs.description:
The RSI store slugs that map to a ship of `ships`, with the retired ones flagged, ordered
by `slug`. A curated list, not read from the Archive.

shops.description: The shops of the shop registry with kind, brand and place, ordered by `key`.

source.description: The Archive and Build the catalog was made from.

starmapObjects.description: The starmap objects with their world positions, ordered by GUID.

subHarvestableMultiConfigs.description: The sub harvestable multi configs, what the slots of an object can hold, ordered by GUID.
